dedupe_keys.name: instituto canario de estadistica istac electricity datasets

description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): electricity datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 18 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about electricity; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Producción neta de electricidad según fuentes de energía y sistemas el; Producción neta de electricidad según fuentes de energía. Islas de Can; Valoración del cambio en el precio de la electricidad respecto a otros; Valoración de la variación interanual en el precio de la electricidad . Formats seen: JSON, SHEET, XML, CSV. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
